=== Lead photograph (31 Oct 2026) ===
The lead is a crop of a Spiegel Grove photograph. Exact legal name already on the wiki plus membership in the Star Wars CCG Facebook group (facebook.com/jb.bronson). Gold 78 FL Salt Lake City, Utah. Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot. Identification stays on Talk.
